user_input: What is the notice period for a confirmed employee?
retrieved_contexts:
['Resignation and Exit Policy > 4. Notice Period

Employees on probation are required to serve a notice period of 2 weeks, as defined in the Probation and Confirmation Policy. Confirmed employees are required to serve a notice period of 3 months from the date of formal resignation. The notice period begins from the date of resignation submission and acknowledgment by HR. Employees must remain fully productive, committed, and professional throughout the notice period.', 'Probation and Confirmation Policy > 9. Notice Period During Probation

During the probation period, the notice period for voluntary resignation by the employee is 2 weeks. The notice period for company-initiated separation during probation is also 2 weeks, except in cases of gross misconduct where summary dismissal without notice applies. This is distinct from the confirmed employee notice period, which is 90 days (3 months) as stated in the offer letter and Resignation and Exit Policy.', 'Probation and Confirmation Policy > At a Glance

Standard probation is 6 months (3 months for Bands 1-3), extendable once by up to 3 months. The confirmation letter is issued within 5 working days of the probation end date, and the notice period during probation is 2 weeks for either side. Confirmation is contingent on a clean background verification.', 'Resignation and Exit Policy > At a Glance

Notice period is 2 weeks on probation and 3 months once confirmed; buyout is possible with approval. Knowledge transfer and exit clearance are mandatory, Full and Final settlement completes within 45 days, and relieving and experience letters follow within 7 working days of FnF. Rehire is possible after a 1-year gap for employees in good standing.', 'Employee FAQ > 6. Joining, Probation, and Exit

How long is probation? 6 months as standard, or 3 months for Bands 1-3, extendable once by up to 3 months. Confirmation requires a clean background verification.

What is my notice period? 2 weeks while on probation and 3 months once confirmed. Notice period buyout is possible with management and HR approval.

When do I get my final settlement and relieving letter? Full and Final settlement is processed within 45 days of your last working day, and the relieving and experience letters are issued within 7 working days after FnF.

Can I refer a friend for a job? Yes. Submit the referral through the HRMS Referral Module before the candidate applies. The referral bonus is paid 50 percent when the hire completes 3 months and 50 percent at 6 months.']
response: Confirmed employees are required to serve a notice period of 3 months (or 90 days) from the date of formal resignation. Notice period buyout is also possible with management and HR approval.

user_input: How many days can I work from home per week?
retrieved_contexts:
['Employee FAQ > 3. Work From Home and Attendance

How many days can I work from home? Rutuja Talent Nexus follows a hybrid model: minimum 3 days in office per week, up to 2 WFH days. You must be confirmed with a performance rating of 3 or above to be eligible.

What are the working hours? 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM with a 15-minute grace period, and core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on WFH days. Flexi-time windows are available with manager approval.

Can I work remotely for a longer stretch? Yes, Extended Remote Work of up to 30 working days per calendar year can be requested for relocation, medical, or family-care reasons. See the Work From Home Policy.', 'Work From Home Policy > At a Glance

Hybrid model: minimum 3 office days per week with up to 2 WFH days, available after confirmation with a performance rating of 3 or above. Extended remote work of up to 30 working days per year can be requested. Company laptop and VPN are mandatory, with core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. A one-time home-office setup allowance is provided.', 'Work From Home Policy > 3. Standard Hybrid Work Model

Rutuja Talent Nexus follows a Hybrid Work Model. All eligible employees are required to be present in the office for a minimum of 3 days per week. The designated office days are Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. The standard work-from-home days are Tuesday and Thursday. Team leads and managers may adjust office or WFH days based on project requirements, client meetings, or sprint cycles with a minimum notice of 48 hours. Employees must not assume that WFH days are fixed and non-negotiable. Business requirements take precedence.', "Work From Home Policy > 5. Extended Remote Work

In addition to the standard 2 WFH days per week, employees may apply for Extended Remote Work of up to 30 working days per calendar year. Extended remote work may be required for reasons such as relocation within India, medical necessity with doctor's certificate, or care of a dependent family member. The application must be submitted through HRMS with justification and supporting documents at least 10 working days in advance. Approval requires sign-off from the reporting manager and HR Business Partner. Extended remote work beyond 30 days in a year requires additional approval from the department head and HR Director.", 'Work From Home Policy > 11. Revocation of WFH Privilege

The WFH arrangement is a privilege and not an employee right. It may be revoked entirely or partially in the following circumstances: sustained underperformance during remote work, security incidents caused by negligence during WFH, violation of any clause of this policy, business requirements mandating full in-office presence, or employee being placed on a Performance Improvement Plan. Revocation will be communicated in writing with a minimum of 5 working days notice.']

user_input: When is my salary credited?

["Payroll and Salary Processing Policy > 3. Salary Credit Date

Salary for each calendar month is credited to the employee's registered bank account on or before the last working day of that month. In months where the last working day falls on a public holiday or weekend, salary is credited on the preceding working day. For new joiners whose joining date falls after the payroll cut-off date defined in Section 4, the salary for the partial month of joining is processed along with the following month's payroll. This is known as the cliff period. After 12 months from the grant date, 25 percent of granted options vest at once. Thereafter, an additional 25 percent of the remaining options vest at the end of each subsequent 12-month period. The full vesting schedule is: Year 1 (cliff) is 0 percent, Year 2 is 25 percent, Year 3 is 50 percent, Year 4 is 75 percent, and Year 5 is 100 percent of total options granted.
